ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious ZipExec Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: ZipExec is a Proof-of-Concept (POC) tool to wrap binary-based tools into a password-protected zip file.

sequences.query: (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/generic\\:Microsoft\\_Windows\\_Shell\\_ZipFolder\\:filename\\=.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.zip.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/pass\\:.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/user\\:.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/delete.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*Microsoft\\_Windows\\_Shell\\_ZipFolder\\:filename\\=.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.zip.*"))
